source: 735 I Have Sinned
target: 735 Peccavi

source: The healing agent’s effects and the incineration of the original flames had largely stemmed the bleeding from Lumian’s wounds.
target: Effectus medicamenti curativi et incineratio flammarum originariarum sanguinem ex vulneribus Lumiani paene cohibuerunt.

source: Flesh and blood had even started to regrow and form scabs over his skin.
target: Caro et sanguis etiam denuo crescere et crustas super cutem eius formarent.

source: Putting on the Lie earring, Lumian tried to shift the gruesome hole in his chest and abdomen to a less vital location.
target: Auriculam mendacem induens, Lumian conatus est transferre horrendum foramen in pectore et abdomine ad locum minus vitalem.

source: As he did so, he stared intently at the oil painting hanging on the rocky wall, his thoughts racing.
target: Dum hoc faciebat, intente aspexit picturam oleariam in pariete saxo pendentem, dum cogitationes eius festinanter currerent.

source: As an Overseer, Perle is unlikely to directly engage in combat herself?
target: Ut Praefecta, num Perle vere se in pugnam directe immittet?

source: Has her true form been lurking in the shadows this whole time to avoid any potential mishaps?
target: Num vera forma eius per totum hoc tempus in umbris latebat, ne quid eveniret?

source: But if she had personally intervened, perhaps we would have been defeated long ago, with no chance for any slip-ups…
target: Sed si ipsa personaliter intervenisset, forsitan iam pridem superati fuissemus, sine ullis occasionibus erroris.

source: Furthermore, Perle doesn’t appear overly concerned about capturing me alive.
target: Praeterea, Perle non videtur nimis sollicitus de me in vita capiundo.

source: Doesn’t the failure of her painting version indicate that the Under the Table deal she initiated didn’t meet the requirements?
target: Num defectus eius versionis pictae non indicat quod foedus "sub mensa", quod ipsa incepit, requisitis non satisfecerit?

source: She’s bound to face severe consequences for that in the future.
target: Illa certissime severas consequentias in futurum pati debebit.

source: It’s not as if she’s a fraud…
target: Non enim quasi mendax sit…

source: Coming to this realization, Lumian suddenly came up with a guess:
target: Hoc intellegens, Lumian subito coniecturam fecit:

source: Perle was the sole person to mention capturing me alive.
target: Perle sola fuit quae de me in vita capiendum meminit.

source: There’s no other evidence to support it…
target: Nulla alia testimonia id comprobare possunt…

source: While this may indeed be a request from the other party in the Under the Table transaction, it’s probably not the only one.
target: Etsi hoc quidem posset esse petitio ex parte altera negotii "sub mensa", probabiliter non est sola.

source: It’s likely one of multiple requests and the least critical.
target: Videtur inter multas petitiones esse et momentum eius minimum esse.

source: That’s why, after creating the special mirror world, Perle immediately left this painting behind, allowing her painting version to handle us while she went off elsewhere.
target: Ideo, postquam mundum speculi specialem creavit, Perle statim hanc picturam reliquit, sinens ut eius versio picta de nobis curaret, dum ipsa alibi pergebat.

source: Was she going to carry out the most vital and important requirement?
target: Num illa intendebat exsequi exigentiam maxime vitalem et gravissimam?

source: I can’t fully trust a Broker’s words either…
target: Ego etiam verbis Brokeris non penitus confido…

source: Based on her tone, she seems to have succeeded.
target: Ex tono eius videtur se feliciter obtinuisse.

source: This strongly suggests she’s confident the vortex is on the brink of taking shape.
target: Hoc firmiter indicat eam confidere quod vortex iam in limine formationis sit.

source: It won’t be long before it entraps everyone…
target: Non diutius erit, ut omnes implicet…

source: Apparently, she wasn’t in the vicinity at all.
target: Apparet illa omnino in vicinitate non adfuisse.

source: She merely used the link to her painting self to briefly speak remotely before vanishing completely.
target: Ipsa tantum nexum ad imaginem suam pictam usus est ut brevi sermonem remoto faceret antequam penitus evanuerit.

source: We have no way to track her.
target: Nobis nullus modus est eam detegere.

source: Lumian felt his theory could account for Perle’s actions and certain details from the prior battle.
target: Lumian sensit theoriam suam posse explicare facta Perlei et aliqua notabilia proelio pristino.

source: This realization made his heart sink.
target: Haec revelatio cor eius deprimere fecit.

source: If his suspicions were correct, the School of Truth’s vortex hadn’t been successfully halted and was about to manifest!
target: Si suspiones eius recte fuerint, vortex Scholae Veritatis non reposita est sed manifestari iam parabat!

source: What would transpire after some time had passed?
target: Quid eveniretur post aliquod tempus lapsum?

source: Right then, Mr. K approached Lumian, his gaze locked on the tattered oil painting.
target: Tum statim, Dominus K ad Lumian accessit, oculos in picturam oleariam laceratam fixos habens.

source: In a hoarse voice, he spoke, “I have sinned. I failed to discover the School of Truth’s scheme beforehand, letting the issue escalate until it was on the verge of erupting.”
target: Voce rauca dixit: "Peccavi. Defui consilium Scholae Veritatis prius deprehendere, sinens rem crescere usque ad limen erumpendi pervenire."

source: As he talked, the flesh on Mr. K’s shoulders writhed, and two pale, slender, damp arms gradually grew out.
target: Dum loquebatur, caro super humeros Domini K contorquebatur, et duo pallida, gracilia, umida brachia paulatim creverunt.

source: The black robe, its sleeves severed, was beyond repair.
target: Habitus niger, cui manicae discerpta erant, ultra reparari non poterat.

source: Not waiting for Lumian to respond, Mr. K turned his head and said, “The disturbance here will soon be noticed. We shouldn’t stay. Meet me tomorrow morning.”
target: Nondum exspectans responsionem Lumiani, Mr. K vertit caput et dixit: "Hic tumultus mox notabitur. Non manere debemus. Cras mane mecum convenite."

source: “Got it.” Lumian glanced at his companions, who had concealed themselves in the shadows or used Psychological Invisibility, and nodded subtly.
target: “Intelligo.” Lumian conspexit socios suos, qui in umbris se celaverant aut invisibilitate psychologica utebantur, et leniter caput nutavit.

source: He also intended to head to the safe house as quickly as possible to avoid any accidental attacks by official Beyonders.
target: Etiam destinavit quam celerrime ad domum tutam pervenire, ne quid inopinatum a officialibus Beyonders incideret.

source: Once Mr. K teleported away, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony came out of hiding.
target: Postquam Mr. K teleporteravit, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony ex latebris exierunt.

source: “We should get back to the safe house now,” Lumian said decisively.
target: “Ad domum tutam nunc redire debemus,” Lumian firmiter dixit.

source: Franca nodded and said with regret and sorrow, “I wonder where Pride Armor was sent. It would be such a shame if we truly lost it.”
target: Franca capite nutavit et cum maerore dixit: "Miror quo misit Armaturam Superbiae. Dolendum esset, si vere eam amisimus."

source: If Pride Armor hadn’t hit Overseer Perle’s painted self, compelling her to alter her life form and indirectly making the transformed Punishers disappear, even if Lumian could have still found a way to lure out the Islander swindler, Monette, they wouldn’t have survived the following stages.
target: Si Armatura Superbiae non percussisset imaginem pictam Perlei, quae eam coegit formam vitae mutare et indirecte efficit ut Poenatores transformati evanuerent, et etiamsi Lumian viam invenisset ad decipiendum fraudatorem insularum, Monette, non supervissent gradus sequentis.

source: In that case, he would face not only Perle’s punishment but also Anthony’s Punisher.
target: In hoc casu, non solum poena Perlei, sed etiam Punitorem Anthoni, ei immineret.

source: For Lumian and the others, Pride Armor had performed exceptionally; it was a Sealed Artifact of tremendous value.
target: Pro Lumiano et ceteris, Armatura Superbiae eximie perfuncta erat; erat artefactum sigillatum ingentis pretii.

source: Nobody wanted it to be lost.
target: Nemo voluit ut illud perderetur.

source: “If it were human and smart, it could find its way back. But now…” Lumian sighed, grasping Anthony’s shoulder with his left hand.
target: “Si esset humanum et sapientem, viam reverteri posset. Sed nunc…” Lumian suspiravit, apprehendens humerum Anthoni sinistra manu.

source: Suddenly, dazzling starlight emerged from the void, rapidly forming a dreamlike door.
target: Subito, lux siderea fulgida ex vacuo emersit, celeriter formans ianuam somniorum similem.

source: The door opened, and out came Magician, Judgment, and Hermit.
target: Ianuam aperta, et ex ea egressi sunt Magus, Iudicium, et Eremita.

source: Surveying the scene, Magician noticed Lumian’s dire condition, one arm missing.
target: Contemplans scenam, Magus animadvertit conditionem direm Lumiani, cui unum brachium defuerat.

source: With an odd expression, she asked, “You were attacked?”
target: Cum vultu insolito, illa quaesivit: "Oppugnatus es?"

source: As she spoke, the quarry cave, lit solely by the carbide lamp’s glow, darkened, as if an unseen curtain had been pulled around it.
target: Dum illa loquebatur, spelunca, sola luce lampadis carbidici illustrata, obscurata est, quasi velum invisibile circa eam traheretur.

source: “Yes,” Franca replied on behalf of Lumian, who had only gained enough reprieve from his injuries to avoid imminent death.
target: “Ita,” Franca respondit pro Lumiano, qui modo satis remissionem vulnerum suorum adeptus erat, ne mortem imminentem afficeret.

source: She concisely recounted the whole situation.
target: Enarravit breviter totam rem.

source: “The one who attacked you came from Perle’s painted self. Her true form departed to do something else?” Magician sought confirmation.
target: “Qui te oppugnaverat, ex imagine picta Perlei venit; vera forma eius discessit ad aliquid faciendum?” Magus confirmationem petivit.

source: “That appears to be the case,” Lumian responded.
target: “Ita videtur,” Lumian respondit.

source: Magician exchanged glances with Judgment and Hermit, their eyes meeting without hiding their bewilderment.
target: Magus oculos cum Iudicio et Eremita commutavit, quorum oculi conveniebant, nec celabant stupefactionem.

source: After a short pause, Magician offered no explanation.
target: Post breve silentium, Magus nullam explicationem dedit.

source: Starlight gathered in her eyes, as if tracing a pattern.
target: Lux siderum in oculis eius congregata est, quasi figuram describeret.

source: A gentle rain fell, soaking Lumian’s body and fully healing his wounds.
target: Pluvia lenis cecidit, corpus Lumiani impregnans et vulnera eius plene sanavit.

source: Nourished by the rain, Franca and the others felt their weariness melt away.
target: Alimentati pluvia, Franca et ceteri sensit lassitudinem suam evanescere.

source: It closely resembles the power Madame Night used in the dream… Lumian drew a connection.
target: Similitudinem habet virtutis, quam Domina Nox in somnio usus est… Lumian coniunctionem traxit.

source: Magician nodded and instructed, “Provide me the details in writing tomorrow.”
target: Magus nutavit capite et inquit: "Crastino die mihi in scriptis singula reddas."

source: With that, she disappeared along with Judgment and Hermit.
target: Hoc facto, illa simul cum Iudicio et Eremita evanuit.

source: As the darkness around them lifted, Lumian realized they had returned to the safe house in the administrative district, where Jenna had summoned Judgment’s messenger.
target: Cum tenebrae circa eos sublevatae essent, Lumian intellexit eos ad domum tutam in regione administrativa rediisse, ubi Jenna nuntium Iudicii vocaverat.

source: “Madam Magician and the others are perplexed that we were attacked by Perle’s painting self,” Anthony remarked while putting away the blank painting collection, voicing his thoughts.
target: “Domina Magus et ceteri perplexi sunt quod a imagine picta Perlei aggressi simus,” Anthony dixit, dum collectionem picturarum inanarum reponeret.

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “What’s perplexing shouldn’t be Perle attacking us. It’s not unusual for an Overseer with an Under the Table transaction at the heart of it all to do something like that.”
target: Lumian nutavit capite et respondit: "Id quod perplexum facit non debet esse per se, ut Perle nos oppugnet. Non est insolitum ut Praefecta, cum foedo 'sub mensa' contracto, talem rem agat."

source: “So what were they perplexed about?” Jenna and Franca couldn’t figure out an answer.
target: “De quo ergo erant perplexi?” Jenna et Franca responsum invenire non potuerunt.

source: Anthony tried to analyze the situation.
target: Anthony conatus est rem analysare.

source: “They’re not perplexed by Perle’s attack itself, but why we were targeted by her painted self specifically.
target: “Non ipsa Perle oppugnatione sunt perplexi, sed cur speciatim a imagine picta eius nos petierit.

source: “They seem to think we wouldn’t be attacked by Perle directly. Whether she had such intentions or acted on them is irrelevant.”
target: Videtur illis esse cogitandum nos non a Perle directe oppugnatos futuros esse. Sive illa talia propositum habuerit, sive egerit, nihil refert.”

source: Lumian and the others became lost in thought.
target: Lumian et ceteri in cogitatione amersi sunt.

source: Abruptly, Franca exclaimed.
target: Subito, Franca exclamavit.

source: Looking at Lumian and the others, she slowly withdrew her hand from her Traveler’s Bag in astonishment.
target: Intuens in Lumian et ceteros, manus sua ex sacculo Viatoris lente se recepit, stupens.

source: “Pride Armor is in here. It’s returned!”
target: “Armatura Superbiae hic est. Rediit!”

source: “Did Madam Magician help locate it?” As this thought crossed Lumian’s mind, he noticed Franca’s actions.
target: “Num Domina Magus adiuvit ut eam inveniret?” Hac cogitatione Luminum, Francae actiones animadvertit.

source: He instantly shouted, “Stop!”
target: Statim exclamavit: "Siste!"

source: He couldn’t allow Franca to retrieve the Pride Armor!
target: Non poterat Francam sinere ut Armaturam Superbiae recuperaret!

source: This is a confined room, and I’m present!
target: Hoc conclave est restrictum, et ego adsum!

source: Franca’s expression froze, and she immediately stopped moving her elbow.
target: Vultus Francae congelatus est, et statim motum cubiti eius cessavit.

source: In the mirror world created by dark void tunnels, Overseer Perle continuously moved from mirror to mirror, searching for her final destination.
target: In mundo speculi, creato per tenebrosos tunelos vacui, Praefecta Perle continue se movebat ab speculo ad speculum, ultimam destinationem quaerens.

source: Her expression stayed calm, thrilled that the calamity had instead accelerated the vortex’s formation.
target: Vultus eius manebat placidus, exsultans quod calamitas formationem vortex acceleraverit.

source: On the other side of the dark, vacant tunnel, a vibrant ball of yarn quietly trailed her, leaving a concealed path.
target: In altera parte tuneli obscuri et vacui, globus vivax lanae eam silentio secutus est, viam occultam relinquit.

source: The next morning, having sent the letter to Magician, Lumian reached Psychic’s headquarters and met Mr. K in the basement.
target: Die sequenti mane, epistolam ad Magum missam, Lumian sedem Psychici attigit et in hypogaeo cum Mr. K convenit.

source: Both their limbs had been restored.
target: Utrorumque membrorum restituta erant.

source: Clad in an enormous hood and black robe, Mr. K disregarded this.
target: Indutus ingenti cuculla et toga nigra, Mr. K hoc neglexit.

source: In a grating voice, he told Lumian, “Come with me somewhere.”
target: Voce aspera, Mr. K dixit: "Veni mecum alicubi."

source: “For what purpose?” Lumian’s demeanor toward Mr. K had become more at ease after their collaboration the previous night.
target: “Ad quid hoc?” Lumian inquit, quoniam eius habitus erga Mr. K post praeteritam nocturnam cooperationem mitigatus esset.

source: Mr. K nodded and explained, “First, I wish to atone for this incident. Second, through the idol, I want to notify the Lord that you’ve grown and can serve as His envoy. He will make preparations when the moment is right. Have faith in the Lord, and trust Him completely.”
target: Mr. K nutavit et explicavit: "Primum, pro hoc casu veniam expiare volo. Secundo, per idolum, Dominum certiorem facere volo te crevisse et pro eius legato fungi posse. Ipse praeparabit, cum tempus id aptum erit. In Domino crede et Eum penitus confide."

source: Just going to a location with the True Creator’s idol? That’s okay… It would be problematic if I actually had to encounter a god… Lumian bowed his head humbly and said, “It would be my honor.”
target: Ad locum cum idolum Veri Creatoris pergere? Bene est… Incommodum esset, si vere deum obviam ire debeam… Lumian humiliter inclinavit caput et dixit: "Mihi honos esset."

source: Mr. K came up to him, grasped his arm, and transported him into the spirit world via teleportation.
target: Mr. K ad eum accessit, brachium eius arripuit, et eum per viam teleportationis in mundum spirituum transtulit.

source: Traversing dense layers of colors and innumerable indescribable transparent beings, the pair arrived at a cathedral.
target: Transiens densas stratas colorum et innumerabilia entia translucida inenarrabilia, par tandem ad catedralem pervenerunt.

source: The cathedral seemed to be located in a deep valley.
target: Cathedrale videbatur in valle profunda situm esse.

source: Its surface was a watery black, decorated with many human bones.
target: Superficies eius erat aquosus niger, multis ossibus humanis ornata.

source: The top resembled the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s cathedral, forming a hemispherical shape.
target: Summum eius simile erat catedrali Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammarum, figuram hemisphaericam formans.

source: Mr. K silently entered through the open door, his back slightly hunched.
target: Mr. K silentio per ianuam apertam intravit, tergo paulo incurvato.

source: Lumian followed closely behind.
target: Lumian proxime secutus est.

source: Then, he saw the vast but dimly lit prayer hall and an enormous, pitch‑black cross standing in the cathedral’s depths.
target: Tum vidit amplum sed vix lucentem conclave orationis et immensum crucem nigerrimum in profundis cathedralis stantem.

source: A naked male idol hung upside down from the cross.
target: Idolum masculinum nudum a cruci versa pendebat.

source: Rust-colored iron nails jutted out from various parts of its body, each nail stained with vivid red blood.
target: Clavi ferrei rubiginosi ex variis partibus corporis eius protruebantur, singuli sanguine rubeo vividis tincti.

source: Is this the True Creator’s idol? Lumian’s heart raced as he quickly averted his gaze.
target: Num hoc est idolum Veri Creatoris? Cor Lumiani palpitabat, et celeriter oculos avertit.

source: What he had seen in the Church of The Fool, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and the God of Steam and Machinery Church were merely Sacred Emblems.
target: Quae viderat in Ecclesia Stulti, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flammarum, et Ecclesia Dei Vaporis et Machinarum, nihil aliud erant quam Emblema Sacra.

source: There were no idols.
target: Nulla idola erant.

source: He had assumed Mr. K was referring to the Sacred Emblem as an idol.
target: Existimaverat Mr. K referre ad Emblema Sacrum tamquam idolum.

source: Mr. K walked until he was four to five meters from the idol and halted.
target: Mr. K processit usque ad quattuor vel quinque metra ab idolo, deinde cessavit.

source: Lumian trailed slightly behind and stopped.
target: Lumian paulo post eum sequebatur et subsedit.

source: As he made his way from the entrance, he got a clear look at the hanging idol’s face.
target: Dum ex introitu procedebat, lucide vultum idoli pendentis conspexit.

source: Its nose, mouth, and ears were quite blurry, with only a rough outline.
target: Nasus, os, et aures eius plane obscuri erant, tantum lineamenta rudia exhibebant.

source: However, its eyes were very distinct and tightly closed, as if enduring all the pain and guilt.
target: Tamen oculi eius valde distincti erant et strictissime clausi, quasi totum dolorem et culpam ferre deberent.

source: Mr. K drew a cross on his chest and cried out in a raspy voice, “Praise you! Praise you for creating everything! Praise you for shouldering the world’s sins!”
target: Mr. K in pectore suo crucem delineavit et voce rauca exclamavit: "Laudare te! Laudare te pro omni creatione tua! Laudare te quod mundi peccata suscepisti!"

source: Lumian followed suit in offering praise.
target: Lumian similiter laudem obtulit.

source: Abruptly, his head spun, and his eyes burned with a sense of familiarity.
target: Subito, caput eius vertit, et oculi eius ardere coeperunt cum sensu familiaritatis.

source: Wh— Lumian’s spiritual intuition alerted him that the negative effects of the Baynfel contract had been triggered.
target: Quid— Intuitio spiritualis Lumiani eum monuit effectus negativos contractus Baynfel excitatos esse.

source: The effect was: In scenes intimately connected to Baynfel’s past, he would witness truths better left unknown.
target: Effectus fuit: in scaenae, quae intime ad praeterita Baynfel pertinent, veritates perspiceret, quae melius ignota manerent.

source: This place is closely tied to Baynfel’s past? Was he once a clergyman of the True Creator?
target: Hic locus intime ad praeteritum Baynfel connexus est? Num olim clericus Veri Creatoris fuerit?

source: Lumian suppressed his curiosity as he continued to focus on the ground.
target: Lumian curiositatem suam repressit, dum in terram intuebatur.

source: Suddenly, his eyes froze.
target: Subito, oculi eius congelaverunt.

source: He spotted a blurry, lizard‑like creature.
target: Animadvertit creaturam confusam, lacertae similem.

source: It was the lizard‑like elf that had appeared in his dream about Cordu.
target: Erat ille elfus, lacertae similis, qui in somnio de Cordu apparuerat.

source: The same one that had crawled out of Aurore’s mouth!
target: Idem qui ex ore Aurorae evasit!

source: It might have influenced Aurore, stopping her from seeking Hela’s help in time!
target: Fortasse Aurorem influerit, eam prohibens ut auxilium Helae tempore quaereret!

source: At the conclusion of the Tree of Shadow incident, the lizard‑like elf had also made an appearance.
target: Ad finem incidentis Arboris Umbrae, ille elfus, lacertae similis quoque apparuit.

source: Why was it present now, in the True Creator’s cathedral?
target: Cur nunc aderat in catedrali Veri Creatoris?

source: As Mr. K sprawled on the ground, pressing his face firmly against the watery black stone bricks, Lumian instinctively looked up.
target: Dum Mr. K in terra iacebat, faciem suam firmiter contra lateres lapideos nigros aquosos prementem, Lumian instinctu surrexit.

source: He witnessed the huge pitch‑black cross transform into an illusory shape, as if it loomed over a mountain range’s peak.
target: Vidit magnum crucem nigerrimum in formam illusoriam mutari, quasi super culmen montanum eminentem.

source: On the indistinct figure hanging upside down, lizard‑like elves crawled in and out, circling and dancing…
target: In figura indistincta versa, elfi lacertae similes in et ex subambulabant, circulantes atque saltantes…

source: Lumian watched the scene in a daze as Mr. K’s slightly muffled voice resounded in his ears.
target: Lumian scenam in attonitione contemplabatur, dum vox modice submissa Mr. K in auribus eius resonabat.

source: “Oh, merciful Father, I implore your mercy for the transgressions I’ve made.”
target: “O, misericors Pater, veniam tuam pro delictis meis imploro.”

source: End of Volume—Sinner
target: Finis Voluminis—Peccator
